name: search round 5: independent evidence
rule: only papers never seen before (seen.json, every earlier search/assessment record, every autonomous run named by an arXiv id) are assessed
procedure: benchmark_search.run_r5: 5 queries, v2 requirements per case with missing information separated, code assessment, feasible 2D cases carried through

predictions.I1_assessed: at least 6 unseen candidates are assessed
predictions.I2_feasible: at least one unseen candidate is declared feasible
predictions.I3_end_to_end: at least one unseen candidate reaches verdicts with a numerically verified quantity (independent evidence)
predictions.I4_consistency: no carried candidate is refused by the definition step for a capability the registry lists as missing
